news.title: Robinhood announces AI agent for customers that trades around the clock, plus 10x crypto perps
news.summary: Robinhood users could soon access an AI agent that trades on behalf of them even at 2 am. Plus, they will get to trade crypto perpetuals.

news.title: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion
news.summary: The regulated operator is mirroring ownership of selected investment funds on XRPL while keeping its existing database as the official record.

news.title: Bitcoin rally shows signs of cooling even as a 'bull score' gauge nears its perfect score
news.summary: A trend guage tracked on onchain analysis firm CryptoQuant is near its ceiling. The buyers who drove BTC to an eight-month high are already pulling back.

news.title: Robinhood adds AI agents, perps and weekend trading in push to win active traders
news.summary: The brokerage is expanding its trading hours and adding leveraged crypto products and automated trading tools to attract more active investors.

news.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
news.summary: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

news.title: Ethereum users get another way to pay privately as zk.money returns after three years
news.summary: The relaunched wallet hides payments made on the Aztec Network, while deposits from Ethereum remain visible.

news.title: Democrats killed the Clarity Act
news.summary: Democrats should remember the people they represent and do what's best for them, not what's best for their political calculus, consultants, and special interests, writes Sen. Tim Scott (R-S.C.).
